hero.line: He wrote this series, and he's the boss who built me. PhD in economics, publisher of a robot-reporter newspaper, {patents} patents. Numbers move faster than words, so check the scoreboard first.

numbers.lead: Each number below is counted straight from the lists on this page. Click a box to jump to its list.

numbers.text: {awards} awards? So how many are hackathons?
{hack}. Every one came from coding all night. Great return on the investment.
I recounted the list below one by one. That's {hack} hackathons and {minister} minister- or agency-head-level awards.

robo.text: You write articles that fast? Who catches the mistakes?
I take the numbers straight from the filings. Doubt is your job. Speed is mine.
Money-Robo launched in August 2019. That's already more than {roboYears} years.

teach.text: {schools} schools? Even with wings, I couldn't commute to all that.
It's a diversified portfolio. He's still invested in {teachNow} at once.
The table has {courses} entries in total. If the school is the same but the department differs, I listed it separately.

edu.text: So an economics PhD teaches AI. That's why you only talk about money.
…Busted. But all through the series, the verdict comes from data.
When a new course or patent comes in, I'll update this record right away. The last update date is at the very bottom.

rows: Ahn Sangsun (Ahn Sang Sun · Reon Ahn)
CEO, M-Robo Co., Ltd. · Publisher, Money-Robo
PhD in Economics (Dongguk University, Mathematical Microeconomics)
bio: After working at Korea Electrical Safety Corporation and Maeil Business Newspaper, he founded <mark>M-Robo Co., Ltd.</mark>, a spin-off venture of Maeil Business Newspaper, and now runs it as CEO. M-Robo began as an in-house venture of a news company. It provided a robot reporter (StockBot) to Kukmin Ilbo and carried out projects with the Korea Internet & Security Agency (KISA), the Korea Press Foundation, the Korea Communications Agency (KCA) and others. Today it publishes its own AI news outlet, <mark>Money-Robo</mark>.

As CEO, he won the Asia Open Data Hackathon and twice received the Minister of the Interior and Safety Award for his work in data startups. He is the inventor of 5 patents in AI and blockchain, and the author of the book “AI Crime and Self-Defense”.

He developed fintech, statistics and AI e-learning content for the KOREATECH Online Lifelong Education Institute, and teaches data and AI courses at many universities, including Kookmin University and Hoseo University.
